name: Repeat ~Kurikaesareru Toki Soshite...~
original_name: Repeat ～繰り返される刻そして…～
source:
I woke up floating in the air.
Below me, the park is uniquely familiar.

What's going on?

With my head was swimming in confusion, two girls with a strange look in their eyes appeared before me. Are they angels or maybe demons?

They said that I was dead and that in seven days, I am going to heaven or hell and the choice won't be mine. In other words, I am going to live the next seven days as a ghost and those two will watch my every action...

[Translated from [url=http://sirius.product.co.jp/repeat/repeat.htm]the official page[/url]]
translation:
我在半空中醒来。
下方是似曾相识的公园。

发生了什么？

在我一头雾水之际，两个眼神奇异的女孩出现在我面前。她们是天使，还是恶魔？

她们说我已经是死人了，七天后我将前往天堂或地狱，而选择权不在我手中。也就是说，我将以幽灵的形态度过接下来的七天，而这两个人将注视着我的一举一动……

[译自[url=http://sirius.product.co.jp/repeat/repeat.htm]官方网站[/url]]
